Package io.github.roebi.qffxguilib.telemetry

Class ClientSpans

java.lang.Object
io.github.roebi.qffxguilib.telemetry.ClientSpans
public final class ClientSpans extends Object
Factory for client-side OTel spans (JavaFX Application Thread measurements).

All methods require ClientTelemetry.init(String) to have been called first.

Measurement points covered

  1. startQueueWait(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) - time spent in the Platform.runLater() queue
  2. fxEventDispatch(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) - time to execute the FX event on the FAT
  3. verificationWait(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) - time and poll count for state assertion

Typical usage sequence

   // on calling thread (e.g. QFTest agent callback):
   QueueWaitMark mark = ClientSpans.startQueueWait(componentId, stepId);
   Platform.runLater(() -> {
       mark.arrived();   // ends queue span, records wait_ms
       try (ActiveSpan s = ClientSpans.fxEventDispatch(componentId, stepId, "click")) {
           node.fireEvent(event);
       }
   });

   // after runLater completes, on calling thread:
   try (VerificationSpan vs = ClientSpans.verificationWait(componentId, stepId)) {
       while (!condition.isMet()) {
           vs.incrementPollCount();
           Thread.sleep(pollIntervalMs);
       }
   }

    • startQueueWait

      public static QueueWaitMark startQueueWait(String componentId, String stepId)
      Starts a span immediately before calling Platform.runLater(). The span ends when QueueWaitMark.arrived() is called inside the lambda.
      Parameters:
      componentId - QFTest component identifier
      stepId - QFTest test step ID
      Returns:
      a QueueWaitMark; call QueueWaitMark.arrived() on the FAT

      stepId - QFTest test step ID

    • verificationWait

      public static VerificationSpan verificationWait(String componentId, String stepId)
      Start a span for the verification wait loop. The number of poll iterations is recorded automatically when the span closes.
      Parameters:
      componentId - QFTest component identifier
      stepId - QFTest test step ID
      Returns:
      a VerificationSpan; call VerificationSpan.incrementPollCount() each iteration and close when the condition is met
